QuestInfo.name: Picture of a Rainbow
QuestInfo.0: Rainbow Week has begun! Cassandra (who's not good at drawing) wants to ask you a favor. \r\n#b\r\n April 11, 2011 - April 24, 2011.
QuestInfo.1:
Cassandra, who loves to draw but is pretty bad at it, asks you to finish the Rainbow Drawing for Rainbow Week. She tells you that Gaga has all 7 colors of crayons, but he might not let you borrow them if you tell him Cassandra is the one who needs them.
On top of that, he only lends one crayon a day, and the color depends on the day of the week! How can you finish the Rainbow Drawing? #b
 - Monday: Red
 - Tuesday: Orange
 - Wednesday: Yellow
 - Thursday: Green
 - Friday: Blue
 - Saturday: Indigo
 - Sunday: Violet
QuestInfo.2: Sadly, the Rainbow Week is over. \r\n#b\r\n April 11, 2011 - April 24, 2011.

0.0: Voila! Look, I drew a picture of the rainbow. It wasn't easy since I haven't drawn anything in forever. Problem is, it doesn't have any color. I don't have any crayons. Do you think you can finish it for me?

yes.0: Gaga has crayons. He will let you borrow a different color each day. If you ever give up, just return the drawing to me anytime.

no.0: Fine. I don't need your help anyway.

1.0: Wow! You completed the picture! It looks great!

yes.0: Yeah, I know, it's pretty nice. I'm being extra generous.

default.0: You haven't completed the picture yet.

item.0: Where is the picture I gave you?

yes.0: Make sure you complete it this time.
